mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_rooms ( name, address, capacity, open_time, close_time, status ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{address}, #{capacity}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{status} )

sql.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT study_room_id, name, address, capacity, open_time, close_time, status FROM study_rooms WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY study_room_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_rooms WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT study_room_id, name, address, capacity, open_time, close_time, status FROM study_rooms WHERE study_room_id = #{studyRoomId} FOR UPDATE
